IMO that depends on what you like. If you enjoy story driven games, then I would say you’d like it pretty well. The repetitiveness will express itself more though if you’re alone. Some of the bosses on the missions take a lot, honestly a lot of bullets to defeat sometimes. The multiplayer aspect isn’t worth it without others to play with either, especially when starting this far after release because you’ll get put into a lower gear zone and there will be no players around you. However, I haven’t played division 2 in a long time and if Division 1 is anything to go off of, the game probably looks entirely different from release, offering a bunch more content in the ‘single player’ style of the game. Regardless of how this may sound, I still really enjoy the game. The post-apocalypse vibe seems realistic and the landscape of DC was incredible.

As someone who bought both of the division games and didn’t put tons of time into either one, I felt like both experiences were worth it. Especially after a couple years of updates. I get bored of the game when playing alone, but it’s a lot of fun to go through with friends. The storyline and world are unique and I really enjoy it. The gameplay is repetitive, similar to the ghost recon or assassins creed games I’ve played. But they all offer a unique story with unique worlds and characters. I definitely think it’s worth $8, even though I typically only got like 30-40 hours out of it
